item.title: Vance Says Lebanon Was Never Part of U.S.-Iran Cease-Fire Deal
item.summary: The vice president sought to downplay Israel’s continued bombardment of Lebanon, which he insisted had “nothing to do with” Iran.

item.title: White House Knew About Pakistan’s Cease-Fire Post on X Before It Was Sent
item.summary: Pakistan’s prime minister posted a public plea on X for President Trump to extend his Tuesday evening deadline for Iran. The White House was directly involved in shaping the message.

item.title: Has Trump Met His War Goals in Iran?
item.summary: On the first day of the pause, Iran fired missiles and launched drones in the region. It said an oil refinery on Lavan Island had been attacked. Israel continued its strikes in Lebanon.

item.title: As Trump Swings on Iran War, Republicans Leaders in Congress Are Largely Silent
item.summary: In a week in which President Trump has veered from threatening to wipe out Iranian civilization to declaring a cease-fire, Congress is out of session and lawmakers with the power to declare war are mostly in the dark.

item.title: Fed Minutes Show Officials in No Rush to Cut as Iran War Scrambled Outlook
item.summary: The conflict in the Middle East has left the Federal Reserve braced for higher inflation, with more officials open to the possibility of rate increases.

item.title: Oil Prices Fall, but Energy Firms Remain Frozen After U.S.-Iran Deal
item.summary: Analysts said oil and natural gas energy companies would not quickly restore production unless attacks stopped and ships started moving through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: For Trump, Resuming Combat in Iran Would Be Risky, Even if Cease-Fire Expires
item.summary: President Trump knows that even if a cease-fire runs out with no final agreement on the issues dividing Washington and Tehran, the political risk of renewing hostilities is high.

item.title: Gulf Arab nations report a barrage of Iranian attacks since the cease-fire.
What Trump Has Accomplished in Iran After 5 Weeks of War
item.summary: President Trump said that “we have already met and exceeded” his military objectives. But his goals are largely unresolved.

item.title: Hegseth Demands Iran Turn Over Uranium Stockpiles
item.summary: The American defense secretary warned President Trump could still order a commando raid to seize 970 pounds of enriched uranium buried in Isfahan if Iran does not agree.
